en.title: Thermoplastic Flow Control Atlas
en.intro: Explore the decision chain from fluid and duty conditions to material families, valve functions, sealing choices, integration details, and the evidence required for final approval.
en.disclaimer: Preliminary screening only. A candidate shown here is not a chemical-compatibility approval, pressure rating, certification claim, or final product recommendation. Confirm the exact chemical, concentration, temperature, pressure, complete wetted materials, product series, and current manufacturer data.

library.materialIntro: Separate structural body materials from liners, seats, seals, diaphragms, and exposed hardware. Temperature positioning is qualitative and never replaces a product pressure-temperature curve.
library.valveIntro: Start from the process function. Similar-looking valves can differ in cavity design, flow path, shutoff, pressure drop, orientation, torque, and maintenance behavior.
library.fluidIntro: These cards identify the questions and failure mechanisms that change selection. They deliberately avoid universal compatibility claims.
library.search: Search code, use, strength, or constraint

rfq.heading: Build a reviewable RFQ summary
rfq.intro: Unknown fields may be left blank. The output is a clarification aid, not an engineering approval.
rfq.operation: Manual / pneumatic / electric and fail position
rfq.solids: Solids, crystallization, viscosity, or gas release
rfq.documents: Required standards, certificates, drawings, and tests
rfq.notes: Installation, cleaning, outdoor, packaging, and delivery notes

sources.heading: Standards and evidence map
sources.intro: Standards define test or product requirements; they do not by themselves prove that a particular product is suitable for a particular chemical duty.
sources.modelIntro: Download the structured knowledge model for backup, review, or later integration with CRM, quotation, training, or supplier-audit systems.

en.offline: The tool runs entirely in the browser after loading; no RFQ data is sent by this page.

zh.title: 热塑性防腐流体控制全景图
zh.intro: 从流体与工况出发，逐层连接材料体系、阀门功能、密封内件、接口与执行方式，以及最终批准所需的技术证据。
zh.disclaimer: 本工具只用于初步筛选。页面中的“候选”不等于化学兼容批准、压力等级承诺、认证声明或最终产品推荐。必须针对准确化学品、浓度、温度、压力、全部接液材料、具体产品系列和制造商当前资料进行确认。

result.heading: 初步评审路径
result.materials: 阀体 / 衬里材料起点
result.seals: 密封 / 隔膜材料起点

library.materialIntro: 必须区分结构阀体、衬里、阀座、密封、隔膜和外露金属件。温度定位只是定性提示，不能替代具体产品的压力—温度曲线。
library.valveIntro: 先定义工艺功能，再选择阀名。外观相似的阀门，可能在阀腔、流道、关闭性能、压降、安装方向、扭矩和维护方式上完全不同。
library.fluidIntro: 这些场景用于识别会改变选型的提问与失效机理，因此刻意不提供脱离浓度、温度和产品系列的万能兼容结论。
library.search: 搜索代码、用途、优势或限制

rfq.heading: 生成可评审的 RFQ 摘要
rfq.intro: 不知道的项目可以留空。输出用于澄清需求，不构成工程批准。
rfq.fluid: 准确流体或化学品名称
rfq.temperature: 正常 / 最低 / 最高温度
rfq.pressure: 正常 / 最大压力或真空
rfq.flow: 流量范围或计量泵数据
rfq.materials: 已知材料偏好或禁用材料
rfq.operation: 手动 / 气动 / 电动及故障位
rfq.solids: 颗粒、结晶、黏度或析气情况
rfq.documents: 标准、认证、图纸与测试要求
rfq.notes: 安装、清洗、户外、包装及交期备注

sources.heading: 标准与证据地图
sources.intro: 标准可以规定产品或试验要求，但仅仅声称符合某项标准，并不能证明某一具体产品适用于某一化学工况。
sources.modelIntro: 下载结构化知识模型，用于备份、复核，或以后接入 CRM、报价、培训和供应商审核系统。

zh.offline: 页面加载后全部计算均在浏览器本地完成，本页不会发送 RFQ 数据。

note.en: The broadest material range may be available, subject to the exact chemical and product curve.
note.zh: 候选材料通常最宽，但仍需结合准确介质和具体产品曲线。

note.en: Pressure derating, seal life, thermal expansion, and joint method become more influential.
note.zh: 压力降额、密封寿命、热膨胀和连接工艺开始显著影响选择。

note.en: The candidate range narrows; confirm long-term pressure capability and chemical resistance together.
note.zh: 候选范围明显收窄，必须同时核对长期承压能力和化学耐受性。

note.en: Common thermoplastic ranges may be exceeded. Product-specific engineering or a lined/alternative construction is usually required.
note.zh: 可能超出普通热塑性产品范围，通常需要具体系列工程确认或衬里/替代结构。

note.en: Confirm vacuum rating, collapse resistance, permeation, orientation, and pump suction transients.
note.zh: 核对真空等级、抗失稳、渗透、安装方向及泵吸入瞬态。

note.en: Low pressure does not remove chemical, water-hammer, trapped-liquid, or vacuum risk.
note.zh: 低压不代表没有化学、水锤、困液升压或真空风险。

note.en: Confirm the product pressure-temperature curve and the rating of every connection and accessory.
note.zh: 核对具体产品压力—温度曲线，以及每个连接件和附件的额定值。

note.en: Series availability becomes narrower; actuator torque, surge, flange loading, and long-term creep require close review.
note.zh: 可选系列减少，执行器扭矩、冲击、法兰载荷与长期蠕变需要重点评审。

note.en: Treat as specialist service. Do not extrapolate a lower-pressure thermoplastic valve rating.
note.zh: 按专项工况处理，不得从低压热塑性阀门额定值外推。

note.en: Compare pressure drop, cavity design, seal friction, and maintenance access.
note.zh: 重点比较压降、阀腔结构、密封摩擦和维护空间。

note.en: Review seat wear, small clearances, check-valve internals, and installation orientation.
note.zh: 核对阀座磨损、小间隙、止回阀内件和安装方向。

note.en: Avoid trapped cavities and dead zones; define venting, flushing, draining, and shutdown behavior.
note.zh: 避免困液阀腔和死区，并定义排气、冲洗、排空及停机状态。

label.zh: 磨蚀 / 纤维 / 高固含

note.en: Prefer open flow paths and replaceable wear parts; verify velocity, particle hardness, and settling.
note.zh: 优先开阔流道和可更换磨损件，并核对流速、颗粒硬度和沉降。

note.en: Confirm operating torque, handle clearance, lockout, extension, and access.
note.zh: 核对操作扭矩、手柄空间、锁定、延长杆和人员可达性。

note.en: Confirm valve torque with safety factor, air pressure, fail position, solenoid, switches, and cycle rate.
note.zh: 核对含安全系数的阀门扭矩、气源压力、故障位、电磁阀、限位开关和循环频率。

note.en: Confirm supply, duty cycle, enclosure, travel time, manual override, feedback, and ambient conditions.
note.zh: 核对电源、工作制、外壳防护、行程时间、手动超越、反馈与环境条件。

note.en: Confirm control signal, positioning accuracy, valve characteristic, deadband, fail action, and valve authority.
note.zh: 核对控制信号、定位精度、流量特性、死区、故障动作和阀权度。

note.en: Confirm pipe material, solvent-cement or fusion procedure, socket standard, union seal, and removal clearance.
note.zh: 核对管材、粘接或热熔工艺、承插标准、由令密封和拆卸空间。

note.en: Confirm NPT/BSP type, thread sealant compatibility, torque limits, and cyclic loading.
note.zh: 核对 NPT/BSP 形式、螺纹密封剂兼容性、拧紧扭矩和循环载荷。

note.en: Confirm drilling standard, gasket, backing ring, bolt torque, support, alignment, and face-to-face dimension.
note.zh: 核对法兰孔制、垫片、背环、螺栓扭矩、支撑、对中和结构长度。

label.zh: 对接 / 承插 / 红外焊接

note.en: Confirm compatible resin system, qualified equipment, operator procedure, bead control, and inspection records.
note.zh: 核对同体系树脂、合格设备、操作程序、焊珠控制和检验记录。

en: Is trapped-cavity relief or venting required?
Is lockout, draining, or frequent removal required?
zh: 是否需要阀腔泄压或排气？
是否需要锁定、排空或频繁拆卸？

en: What are minimum and maximum flow and differential pressure?
What valve characteristic and control accuracy are required?
What is the required fail action?
zh: 最小/最大流量和压差是多少？
需要什么流量特性和控制精度？

en: Are solids, pulsation, or water hammer present?
zh: 允许的开启压力是多少？
是否存在颗粒、脉动或水锤？

en: What are the metering-pump capacity and stroke behavior?
What are suction, discharge, and injection-point pressures?
Where do relief flow and calibration return?
zh: 计量泵流量和冲程特性是什么？
吸入、排出和注射点压力是多少？
泄压回流和标定液返回哪里？

en: What are solids content, particle size, hardness, and settling behavior?
Which wear parts must be replaceable?
zh: 固含量、粒径、硬度和沉降特性是什么？
哪些磨损件必须可更换？

label.zh: 背压 / 泄压 / 减压

en: Which equipment or pressure must be protected or stabilized?
What are normal, minimum, and upset flow rates?
Where will relieved fluid discharge safely?
zh: 需要保护或稳定哪台设备/哪个压力？
正常、最小和异常流量是多少？
泄放介质将安全排向哪里？

en: Which flow paths are permitted in every position?
zh: 每个位置允许哪些流路？
切换过程中端口能否重叠？

role.en: Valve bodies, pipe, fittings, unions, flanges
role.zh: 阀体、管材、管件、由令、法兰

en: Broad water and many acid/alkali starting applications
Rigid, widely available, multiple connection standards
zh: 水系统及多种酸碱工况的常见起点
刚性好、供应广、连接标准丰富

en: Brittleness/impact risk, especially at low temperature
zh: 低温或冲击条件下的脆裂风险
部分溶剂和氧化剂限制
粘接工艺直接影响可靠性

role.en: Higher-temperature valve bodies, pipe and fittings
role.zh: 较高温度阀体、管材与管件

en: Higher temperature positioning than PVC-U in many product systems
Useful starting point for many corrosive water and chemical duties
Available in ANSI and selected metric systems
zh: 在许多产品体系中比 PVC-U 具有更高温度定位
多种腐蚀性水和化学工况的常见起点
可提供 ANSI 及部分公制体系

en: Still requires strong pressure derating at elevated temperature
Not universally compatible with solvents or oxidizers
Joining compounds and pipe/valve compound compatibility matter
zh: 并非普遍耐受溶剂或氧化剂
粘接剂及管阀材料体系需要匹配
准确浓度下的耐化学表

role.en: Industrial valve bodies, welded piping, tanks and fabricated components
role.zh: 工业阀体、焊接管路、储罐与加工件

en: Broad starting resistance to many acids, alkalis and salts
Lower density and useful abrasion behavior
zh: 对多种酸、碱和盐具有较宽的初筛适用面
密度低且具有一定耐磨优势

en: Oxidizers, hydrocarbons, UV, and low-temperature impact require review
PP-H, PP-R and PP-B are not interchangeable labels
zh: 氧化剂、烃类、紫外及低温冲击需要复核
蠕变和法兰/支撑载荷重要
PP-H、PP-R 与 PP-B 不能混为一谈
PP 具体牌号和稳定剂体系

role.en: Pressure piping and selected valve/fitting systems
role.zh: 压力管道及部分阀门/管件体系

en: Different long-term strength positioning from PP-H
zh: 适用于水及部分工业工况
长期强度定位与 PP-H 不同

en: Industrial chemical valve availability may be narrower
Do not assume compatibility from the generic PP name
zh: 工业化学阀门可选范围可能较窄
不能仅凭“PP”名称推断兼容性
必须确认制造商系统配套性

name.zh: 高密度聚乙烯压力管道体系

role.en: Utility piping, buried systems, large-diameter valves and fabricated components
role.zh: 公用管路、埋地系统、大口径阀门与加工件

en: Useful for water, brine and selected chemicals
zh: 适合热熔连接和埋地应用
常用于水、盐水及部分化学介质

en: Lower stiffness and temperature positioning than several engineering thermoplastics
Permeation and hydrocarbon compatibility require review
Valve availability and operating torque vary by size
zh: 刚度和温度定位低于部分工程塑料
渗透及烃类兼容性需要核对
不同口径的阀门供应和操作扭矩差异大

role.en: Cold-water, cooling, marine and selected low-temperature systems
role.zh: 冷水、冷却、船舶及部分低温系统

en: Common in selected water and marine applications
zh: 常见于部分水和船舶应用

en: Solvents and UV exposure require close review
zh: 耐化学和高温范围较窄
溶剂与紫外暴露需重点评审
不是通用工业防腐材料

role.en: High-performance valve bodies, high-purity piping, liners and wetted components
role.zh: 高性能阀体、高纯管路、衬里与接液部件

en: High-purity grades and good abrasion behavior
zh: 较宽的耐化学初筛范围
可提供高纯等级并具有较好耐磨表现

en: Grade, purity and joining process matter
Strong alkali, some solvents, radiation, permeation and stress conditions still require review
zh: 牌号、纯度和连接工艺重要
强碱、部分溶剂、辐照、渗透与应力条件仍需评审

name.zh: 乙烯—三氟氯乙烯共聚物

role.en: Lining, sheet, coating and selected high-performance piping components
role.zh: 衬里、板材、涂层及部分高性能管路部件

en: Broad chemical and permeation performance in selected severe duties
Useful as a lining or fabricated-material option
Good surface and abrasion characteristics in appropriate systems
zh: 在部分严苛工况中具有较宽的耐化学与抗渗透表现
可作为衬里或加工材料方案
在合适系统中具有良好表面和耐磨特性

en: Valve product availability is limited compared with PVC/PP/PVDF
Fabrication and welding capability are specialized
Supplier data and project qualification are essential
zh: 阀门产品可选性低于 PVC/PP/PVDF
加工与焊接能力专业性高
制造商数据和项目批准不可缺少
渗透与电火花检测记录

name.en: Fluoropolymer seats, diaphragms, liners and wetted parts
name.zh: 氟塑料阀座、隔膜、衬里与接液部件

role.en: Seats, diaphragms, gaskets, liners, tubing and high-purity wetted parts
role.zh: 阀座、隔膜、垫片、衬里、管材及高纯接液件

en: Low friction and useful sealing/lining behavior
PFA supports melt-processed and high-purity constructions
zh: 非常宽的耐化学初筛范围
低摩擦并适合作密封/衬里
PFA 可用于熔融加工及高纯结构

en: PTFE is not normally a load-bearing valve-body material
Creep, cold flow, permeation and mechanical backing matter
zh: PTFE 通常不作为承载阀体材料
蠕变、冷流、渗透和机械支撑重要
填充及改性牌号差异明显
合格体系中的 PFA 焊接

role.en: Large sizes, structural loads, vacuum or duties beyond solid-plastic geometry
role.zh: 大口径、较高结构载荷、真空或超出实心塑料结构能力的工况

en: Separates structural strength from corrosion barrier
Useful for larger equipment and severe mechanical loads
zh: 把结构强度与防腐屏障分开
适用于大型设备和较高机械载荷

en: Liner damage, permeation, pinholes and flange sealing can dominate life
External corrosion of the support structure remains possible
Repair and inspection require specialist methods
zh: 衬里损伤、渗透、针孔和法兰密封可能决定寿命
支撑结构仍可能发生外腐蚀
维修与检验需要专业方法

en: Water, many dilute acids/alkalis, weathering and steam in suitable grades
zh: 水、多种稀酸稀碱、耐候及合适牌号下的蒸汽工况

en: Oils, fuels, many hydrocarbons and some concentrated chemicals
zh: 油、燃料、多种烃类及部分高浓度化学品

en: Compound formulation, cure system, temperature, compression set and certification
zh: 配方、硫化体系、温度、压缩永久变形和认证

en: Many oils, fuels, solvents and higher-temperature duties in suitable compounds
zh: 合适配方下的多种油品、燃料、溶剂及较高温工况

en: Strong alkalis, hot water/steam, amines and some polar chemicals vary greatly by grade
zh: 强碱、热水/蒸汽、胺类及部分极性化学品对不同牌号影响差异大

en: FKM family/grade, exact chemical, decompression, temperature and swelling
zh: FKM 具体体系/牌号、准确化学品、减压、温度和溶胀

en: Many oils and water services, good mechanical properties, common availability
zh: 多种油品和水工况、较好的机械性能、供应普遍

en: Weathering, ozone, strong oxidizers, ketones and many aggressive chemicals
zh: 耐候、臭氧、强氧化剂、酮类及多种强腐蚀化学品

en: Acrylonitrile content/compound, ambient exposure, temperature and exact media
zh: 丙烯腈含量/配方、环境暴露、温度和准确介质

en: Broad chemical-resistance starting range, low friction, common seats and gaskets
zh: 耐化学初筛范围宽、低摩擦、常用于阀座和垫片

en: Cold flow, creep, permeation, recovery and wear under cycling
zh: 冷流、蠕变、渗透、回弹性及循环磨损

en: Virgin/filled/modified grade, backing, load, temperature and seat design
zh: 纯料/填充/改性牌号、背衬、载荷、温度和阀座设计

en: Very broad chemical and temperature capability in appropriate grades
zh: 合适牌号下具有很宽的耐化学和温度能力

en: Very high cost, grade-specific limits, availability and lead time
zh: 成本很高、不同牌号限制不同、供应与交期

en: Exact grade, temperature, pressure cycling, purity and economic justification
zh: 准确牌号、温度、压力循环、纯度及经济合理性

en: Combines chemical barrier with flexible backing
Common in corrosive and high-purity diaphragm valves
zh: 兼顾化学屏障与柔性背衬
常用于腐蚀性和高纯隔膜阀

en: Flex life, permeation, backing compatibility, vacuum and installation compression
zh: 弯曲寿命、渗透、背衬兼容性、真空及安装压缩量

en: Face/backing materials, cycle data, pressure-temperature, orientation and maintenance interval
zh: 覆层/背衬材料、循环数据、压力—温度、方向和维护周期

en: Skids, samples, drains and dosing lines
zh: 撬装、取样、排放和加药管路

en: Ordinary designs are not general-purpose throttling valves
Trapped cavity, crystallization and gas generation
zh: 普通结构不应默认用于节流
阀座扭矩和执行器选型

en: Modulating flow where a characterized insert or ball is available
zh: 具有特性内件/球体的连续流量调节

en: Do not use on/off Cv as a control curve
zh: 阀权度和执行器分辨率
不能把开关阀 Cv 当作调节特性

en: Diverting, selecting, mixing and bypass arrangements
zh: 分流、选择、混合和旁路布置
交叉污染和封闭端升压

en: Disc remains in the flow path
Flange ID, gasket practice and actuator torque
zh: 法兰内径、垫片方式和执行器扭矩

en: Corrosive, dirty, slurry, high-purity or dead-leg-sensitive duty
zh: 腐蚀、脏污、浆液、高纯或死区敏感工况
真空、安装方向和循环频率

en: Pulsation, water hammer, solids and spring compatibility
zh: 脉动、水锤、颗粒和弹簧兼容性
球式/升降/弹簧/旋启结构

en: Applications needing a repeatable flow characteristic
zh: 明确的节流与调节任务
需要可重复流量特性的应用
执行器推力和控制稳定性

en: Safe relief destination and diaphragm compatibility
zh: 安全泄放位置和隔膜兼容性

en: Abrasive slurry, fibrous media and open-flow-path isolation
zh: 磨蚀浆液、纤维介质及开阔流道隔离

en: Pump protection, calibration, injection, pulsation and maintainability
zh: 泵保护、标定、注射、脉动控制和可维护性
注射点压力和化学品结晶

summary.en: Water chemistry, disinfectants, suspended solids, cleaning and pressure transients still govern selection.
summary.zh: 即使是水，也必须考虑水质、消毒剂、悬浮物、清洗和压力瞬态。

en: Do not assume every water-grade product is suitable for chemicals used during cleaning or disinfection.
zh: 不能因为产品适用于水，就默认其适用于清洗或消毒时使用的化学品。

en: Is the water potable, ultrapure, seawater, wastewater, or process water?
What disinfectants and cleaning chemicals contact the valve?
Are surge, vacuum, outdoor exposure, or suspended solids present?
zh: 属于饮用水、超纯水、海水、废水还是工艺水？
阀门会接触哪些消毒剂和清洗剂？
是否存在冲击压力、真空、户外暴露或悬浮物？

summary.en: Product-level hygienic approval and the exact certified size/material configuration matter in addition to corrosion resistance.
summary.zh: 除耐腐蚀外，还必须核对产品级卫生认证以及证书覆盖的准确口径和材料配置。

en: A material name or factory ISO 9001 certificate is not a potable-water product approval.
zh: 材料名称或工厂 ISO 9001 证书不等于饮用水产品认证。

en: Which market and approval scheme applies?
Does the certificate cover the exact valve, size, seal and pressure class?
What disinfectants and temperatures are used?
zh: 适用哪个市场和认证体系？
证书是否覆盖准确阀型、口径、密封和压力等级？
使用什么消毒剂和温度？

summary.en: Wastewater is not one chemical. Variable pH, solvents, oxidants, solids, oils and cleaning events can create mixed failure mechanisms.
summary.zh: 废水不是一种化学品。波动的 pH、溶剂、氧化剂、固体、油分和清洗会形成复合失效机理。

en: Compatibility must be based on the worst credible mixture, not only an average laboratory result.
zh: 兼容性应基于可信的最不利混合物，而不能只看平均化验值。

en: What chemicals can enter during upset or cleaning?
What are maximum solids and particle size?
Does the line dry, crystallize, or release gas?
zh: 异常或清洗时可能进入哪些化学品？
最大固含和粒径是多少？
管路是否会干燥、结晶或析气？

summary.en: Internal saltwater resistance and external atmospheric corrosion must be reviewed together.
summary.zh: 必须同时评审内部盐水腐蚀和外部盐雾/大气腐蚀。

zh: 外露紧固件/执行器环境

en: A corrosion-resistant body can still contain a vulnerable shaft, spring, fastener or actuator accessory.
zh: 耐腐蚀阀体内部或外部仍可能存在易腐蚀的阀轴、弹簧、紧固件或执行器附件。

en: Is the service natural seawater, concentrated brine, or chlorinated water?
Are marine atmosphere and UV exposure present?
What solids and biological growth are expected?
zh: 介质是天然海水、浓盐水还是含氯水？
是否有海洋大气和紫外暴露？
预计有哪些固体和生物生长？

summary.en: Acid name alone is insufficient. Concentration, temperature, oxidizing behavior, contaminants and stress can reverse a material decision.
summary.zh: 只有酸名称远远不够；浓度、温度、氧化性、杂质和应力可能完全改变材料判断。

en: Sulfuric, nitric, hydrofluoric, hydrochloric and mixed acids must never be treated as one compatibility group.
zh: 硫酸、硝酸、氢氟酸、盐酸和混酸绝不能作为同一兼容类别处理。

en: What is the exact chemical and mass concentration?
What are continuous and cleaning temperatures?
Are oxidizers, dissolved metals, solvents or water dilution present?
zh: 准确化学品和质量浓度是多少？
连续运行和清洗温度是多少？
是否含氧化剂、溶解金属、溶剂或存在稀释放热？

summary.en: Concentration and temperature affect both structural plastics and elastomers; seal selection often differs from acid duty.
summary.zh: 浓度和温度会同时影响结构塑料与弹性体，密封选择通常不同于酸工况。

en: Do not assume fluoroelastomer is automatically the premium choice for hot concentrated caustic.
zh: 不能默认氟橡胶在高温浓碱中一定是“更高级”的选择。

en: What is the concentration across normal, dilution and cleaning conditions?
Can the chemical crystallize during shutdown?
What elastomer compound has the manufacturer approved?
zh: 正常、稀释和清洗状态下浓度分别是多少？
制造商批准了哪种弹性体配方？

summary.en: Oxidizer strength, decomposition, gas generation, concentration decay and trace metals make this a system-level review.
summary.zh: 氧化强度、分解、析气、浓度衰减和痕量金属使其必须按系统级问题评审。

en: A standard closed-cavity ball valve may trap decomposing chemical; vented or diaphragm designs may be considered subject to manufacturer approval.
zh: 普通封闭阀腔球阀可能困住会分解的化学品；经制造商批准后可考虑排气球阀或隔膜阀。

en: What is delivered and operating concentration?
Can the valve trap liquid when closed?
What are storage age, temperature, UV exposure and metallic contamination?
zh: 交付浓度和运行浓度分别是多少？
阀门关闭时是否会困液？
储存时间、温度、紫外和金属污染情况如何？

summary.en: Swelling, dissolution, permeation and stress cracking can affect both body plastics and seals.
summary.zh: 溶胀、溶解、渗透和应力开裂会同时影响阀体塑料与密封。

en: Generic solvent compatibility is unsafe; test the exact blend and every elastomer.
zh: 笼统的“耐溶剂”判断不安全，必须核对准确混合物及每一种弹性体。

en: What is the complete composition including cleaning solvents?
Is the area classified for flammable vapor and is static control required?
zh: 包括清洗溶剂在内的完整组成是什么？
区域是否属于可燃蒸气危险区并需要静电控制？

summary.en: Chemical compatibility, abrasion, settling and geometry must be evaluated together.
summary.zh: 必须同时评估液相化学兼容性、磨蚀、沉降和阀门几何结构。

en: A chemically resistant material can still fail rapidly through erosion or blockage.
zh: 耐化学材料仍可能因冲蚀或堵塞而快速失效。

en: What are solids percentage, particle distribution and hardness?
What is line velocity and minimum flow?
How will the valve be flushed, drained and maintained?
zh: 固含量、粒径分布和硬度是多少？
管内流速和最小流量是多少？
阀门如何冲洗、排空和维护？

label.zh: 超纯水 / 高纯化学品

summary.en: Purity, extractables, surface, dead legs, clean manufacturing and joining quality can matter more than basic corrosion resistance.
summary.zh: 纯度、析出物、表面、死区、洁净制造和连接质量可能比基本耐腐蚀性更重要。

en: A standard industrial PVDF or PP product is not automatically a high-purity product.
zh: 普通工业级 PVDF 或 PP 产品不自动等于高纯产品。

en: What purity, TOC, ionic and particle limits apply?
Is the exact product manufactured and packaged for the required cleanliness class?
What welding, passivation/cleaning and validation documents are required?
zh: 适用什么纯度、TOC、离子和颗粒限值？
具体产品是否按所需洁净等级制造和包装？
需要哪些焊接、清洗和验证文件？

label.zh: 气体 / 压缩空气 / 真空

summary.en: Stored energy, permeation, leakage, decompression and collapse risks require explicit product approval.
summary.zh: 储能、渗透、泄漏、减压和失稳风险要求制造商明确批准。

zh: 快速减压与点燃/静电风险

en: Never apply a liquid-service rating to compressed gas without explicit product and system approval.
zh: 未经具体产品和系统明确批准，绝不能把液体工况额定值直接用于压缩气体。

en: What gas, hazard classification and allowable leak rate apply?
Is the product series explicitly approved for gas or vacuum?
What decompression, permeation, fire and static-control requirements apply?
zh: 气体种类、危险分类和允许泄漏率是什么？
该产品系列是否明确批准用于气体或真空？
减压、渗透、防火和静电控制要求是什么？
必要时的书面工况确认
压力/密封测试方法与记录

en: PED or other legal scope reviewed
zh: 认证覆盖准确产品配置
已评审 PED 或其他法规范围
完成客户合格供应商/equal 流程
报价假设与排除项清晰

sources.title: ISO/TC 138/SC 7 — Valves and auxiliary equipment of plastics materials

scope.en: Catalogue for thermoplastics-valve product and test standards, including ISO 16135–16139, ISO 21787, ISO 8233 and ISO 9393.
scope.zh: 热塑性阀门产品与试验标准目录，包括 ISO 16135–16139、ISO 21787、ISO 8233 和 ISO 9393。

scope.en: General pressure-resistance and leaktightness test methods for industrial thermoplastics valves; excludes gas applications covered elsewhere.
scope.zh: 工业热塑性阀门耐内压和密封性试验的一般方法；不涵盖由其他产品标准规定的气体应用。

scope.en: Hydrostatic test parameters and conditions for valves made from listed thermoplastics.
scope.zh: 规定多种热塑性材料阀门的静液压试验参数与条件。

scope.en: Opening, closing and running torque test method for thermoplastics valves.
scope.zh: 热塑性阀门开启、关闭和运行扭矩的试验方法。

scope.en: Fatigue-strength test method for hand-operated plastics valves; does not itself establish chemical resistance.
scope.zh: 手动塑料阀门疲劳强度试验方法；该标准本身并不证明耐化学性。

scope.en: Manufacturer planning references covering materials, design/installation, valves/actuators, and measurement/control.
scope.zh: 制造商规划资料，覆盖材料、设计安装、阀门执行器及测量控制。

scope.en: Explains why valve function, thermoplastic body material and elastomer compatibility must be evaluated together.
scope.zh: 说明为什么必须同时评估阀门功能、热塑性阀体材料和弹性体兼容性。

scope.en: Official overview of PED 2014/68/EU and its scope for stationary pressure equipment.
scope.zh: 欧盟关于 PED 2014/68/EU 及固定式压力设备适用范围的官方说明。
